name: hermes-deploy-guild
description: A battle-tested deployment guild that installs and configures Hermes (hermes-agent) on remote Windows and macOS machines: environment recon, fast China-friendly mirror install, CLI plus Desktop(GUI) via -IncludeDesktop, provider/model wizard configuration, Sunlogin remote GUI automation, and end-to-end acceptance.

displayDescription.en: A full-auto team that installs Hermes on a remote Windows PC and wires up its LLM provider: recon, fast mirrored install, model config, acceptance.
displayDescription.zh: 远程电脑一键部署Hermes智能体，环境探测、Python安装、模型配置到验收，全自动完成。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 远程电脑上一键装好 Hermes 并配好模型。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Install Hermes on my remote PC and configure the model in one go.

quickPrompts.en: Install Hermes on my remote PC and configure the model in one go.
quickPrompts.zh: 远程电脑上一键装好 Hermes 并配好模型。

quickPrompts.en: Check whether my remote PC can install Hermes and what is missing in the environment.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我看看远程电脑能不能装 Hermes，环境缺什么。

quickPrompts.en: My remote Hermes runs but reports no API key - please fix the configuration.
quickPrompts.zh: 远程 Hermes 装好了但报没有 API key，帮我修配置。
